company.shortDescription: Stablecoin API for global payments — One API. Multiple payment rails.
company.description: BlindPay enables businesses to create virtual U.S. bank accounts with local account details, send and receive payments seamlessly, and operate with low fees, instant settlement, and built-in compliance — delivering the core infrastructure for the next generation of financial services, built for developers.

productsAndServices.description: An API that enables developers to integrate digital dollars and multiple payment rails into their payment flows for instant global transfers and settlements.
productsAndServices.name: BlindPay Payment API

productsAndServices.description: A service for verifying individual and business identities to meet regulatory compliance requirements during onboarding.

productsAndServices.description: A service to add and manage various types of bank accounts across multiple countries and payment systems for payouts and payins.
productsAndServices.name: Bank Account Management

productsAndServices.description: A service to request quotes and execute payouts in digital dollars or fiat currencies with automatic currency consolidation and instant settlements.
productsAndServices.name: Payouts and Settlements

productsAndServices.description: A service to create and manage blockchain wallets for digital dollar transactions, including message signing and wallet custody.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Seed round raised $3,300,000, or 86.84% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $7,687,531 to $21,418,409, a 2.79x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 86 (-3 over 90 days) and market heat at 66 (-2).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.

insights.title: Competitive benchmark reflects the modeled peer set
insights.statement: Crunchbase’s closest modeled peers include BVNK, zerohash, MoonPay.
insights.implication: These matches provide a starting point for comparing differentiation, scale, and shared specialties, but they should not be treated as a verified competitor set.
